title: 研发调用追踪台
thesis: 让业务负责人、Lead、开发 Agent 和 Reviewer 沿着同一条验收条件，逐次签收工作、查看真实产物和退回有证据的问题。
journey: 目标与验收 → 协作路线 → 执行追踪 → 独立核对。确认 v3 后，Lead 在 G1 确认依赖和文件范围并分派 T-07。开发先复现，再提交 diff 与局测。Lead 在 G3 核对后交独立 Reviewer。R-04 通过新成员会话发现排队后撤权仍导出 F-24，退回原任务修复。Reviewer 复审后交 Lead 再确认，活动 09 完成集成合入后确认 G5，活动 10 更新原设计、规则或技能。

references.observed: 作者主页公开发布的 2880 × 2160 视频。3.350 秒的 Traces 图用逐列点亮的橙方格表示轨迹量。本方案借用方格形态，改用有图例的标记区分每项活动的主责和协作人。6.500 秒的平视应用窗口约为 2593 × 1844，左侧图标轨约占宽度 3.7%，两层导航合计约占 20.9%。将窗口等比折算到 1600 px 宽，Runs 明细的 run_agent 与侧栏 Traces 的可见字面均实测约 12 px 高，相邻明细行中心距约 66 px。原片采用近黑底、较亮一层的炭灰资料面、虚线行界、橙色细选中线和有界的紧凑按钮。暖色外框属于作品陈列。该作品 PNG 封面为笔记本透视展示，内部比例根据视频的正面帧读取。

pages.prompt:
Create one polished FLAT APPLICATION SCREENSHOT, 1600 x 960 full bleed for Fouc, a Chinese desktop application managing ADD agent-assisted development. Date 12 November 2026. The two attached images are the real Enigma – AI Agent Dashboard Traces work table (video 6.50s) and an Enigma confirmation dialog. Study the ACTUAL internal design, not Dribbble's artboard: luminous ivory letters on a deep near-neutral obsidian #131313 frame / #1b1b1b table panels, warm amber-orange functional selected tab, modest semibold labels, subdued outlines, dotted row rules and small monochrome controls. Flat orthographic screenshot (no device, no margin, no poster or visible viewport surround). Source contains project picker, run table and statistics but we are designing a different product. Exclude metrics, cost, decorative charts, rings, big numbers and giant headlines. The body must actually look like compact desktop 13 CSS px on this whole 1600x960 working viewport. Headers under 19 px and controls 26 px. A user can see the actual initial working text around y=106-135. Compact icon rail 52px, project navigation column 192px and horizontal project switch at very top only. Use natural Chinese, good typesetting, quiet restrained care of a genuine premium Enigma-style collaborative dev tool. Lots of dark neutral canvas, strictly amber for selected current state and primary action, mint only for checked facts.
Screen: product manager and requirements agent agree on one testable contract. Top bar shows Fouc / 北辰研发 / 研发协作, right compact search. Local side nav four clear cross-screen destinations: 目标与验收 (active), 协作路线, 执行追踪, 独立核对. Their open task is “按筛选导出任务”. Compact title line same size as reference's detail labels, icon, EXP-17, 任务导出设计 v3. One focused split working panel with (left two thirds) a compact discussion and source contract, (right one third) the checkable input/output fixture. Work directly starts in the top 12%. When user 林岚 asks “按当前筛选导出；没有权限的任务怎么办？” 需求 Agent confirms “服务端按发起人权限再筛一次。” Display an inline source revision '任务导出设计 v3' and this exact text 'AC-02  导出结果仅含当前筛选命中且本人可见的任务'. Right fixture is a neatly aligned table of 3 rows: F-17 进行中 可见 导出; F-24 进行中 无权限 排除; F-39 已完成 可见 排除. Show human approval pending with a primary restrained orange '确认 v3 并交给 Lead' button, then '协作路线' destination. Bottom notes may show actual source attachments but never invent spurious metrics, marketing copy or random chart. Use correct Chinese. Single minimal amber focus highlight, small contained outline square icons and narrow source-style inputs. Differentiate headings from body by weight and whitespace. Keep entire frame as a live desktop tool, not as presentation graphics.

pages.prompt: Create ONE focused Enigma-inspired Fouc INDEPENDENT REVIEW work screen, a full bleed orthographic 1600x960 Chinese desktop product screen dated 12 November 2026. Attached real Uxerflow Enigma Traces frame shows precise near-black matte row styling. Attached approved Fouc page establishes the exact family and slim navigation. Use the same dark charcoal chrome, narrow amber selection and dotted rows. Body regular 13 px; first real evidence at y=115, primary page title at most 19px. Nav highlight 独立核对; the other entrances are 目标与验收、协作路线、执行追踪. Project switch 北辰研发 in top bar only. This is independent reviewer R-04 of T-07 / 按筛选导出任务, referencing 任务导出设计 v3 and AC-02. Evidence must be meaningfully different from developer's self-test. The reviewer creates a real '进行中' export, then revokes actor access on F-24 between queueing and file generation, then downloads resulting CSV. Side by side monospaced PREVIEW expected.csv task_id F-17, actual.csv task_id F-17 F-24. Highlight just one incorrect row in muted coral. Small interaction trace calls open filtered view, queue CSV, revoke F-24 read, download raw artifact and compare. Left contains usable evidence, right focused inspector visible decision '退回 T-07 修复' with prefilled repair note '写出 CSV 前按发起人重新校验可见性' and expected independent replay after fix. Downstream conditional '复审通过 → Lead 再确认 → G5 集成合入' threaded with original evidence. G4-task is current decision, not an activity. No cost/metrics cards, no random data, marketing, charts, filler or backdrop. Controlled typography and real work surfaces, tiny muted status icons, investigate mismatch then send fix to implementation from same page.

verification: 已并排目视复核 Uxerflow 两个原作与四张定稿。制图画板为满幅 1600 × 960，先于 DPR 1 校验，再以同一逻辑窗口 2 倍采样并等比回到 1600 × 960，保留中文字形边缘。浏览器读取四页的首条实际工作内容均从 y=115 开始，占视口 12.0%。主表正文字号 12–13 px，查看器测得四页抽样的字面均约高 12 px，和 Traces 1600 px 宽平视窗口的示例行一致。主按钮为 27 px，各页当前区块落在画面内，已校验导航的目标页与像素区域。新方案的双层导航占宽 17.3%，给两列工作物留出空间。页面中的任务、提交号及运行证据为同一演示情境的设计数据。原作图像与视频仅用于作者对照，交付的四张图为内置 ImageGen 探索后由静态排版校准的原创 Fouc 产品效果图。
